html:
/* Template:WorldBossTimetable/styles.css (set the content model to Sanitized CSS)
   The weekly World Boss table. Dark colours are the default, the light theme overrides are at the bottom.
   Sanitized CSS has no CSS variables, so every colour is a literal value. */
.wbt {
	margin: 0.8em 0 1.2em;
	color: #e8e1d6;
	font-size: 14px;
}
.wbt-top {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 10px 14px;
	margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.wbt-tz {
	display: inline-flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 8px;
	margin-left: auto;
	padding: 6px 12px;
	border: 1px solid #6a5340;
	border-radius: 18px;
	background: #241d18;
	font-size: 13px;
}
.wbt-tzlabel { color: #9a9082; }
.wbt-tzname { font-weight: 700; color: #e8e1d6; }
.wbt-tzsel {
	padding: 1px 4px;
	border: 1px solid #6a5340;
	border-radius: 6px;
	background: #1a1715;
	color: #e8e1d6;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.wbt-note { margin-top: 10px; color: #9a9082; font-size: 12px; }
/* the next spawn bar, filled by the script */
.wbt-next {
	display: none;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 10px;
	padding: 5px 14px 5px 6px;
	border: 1px solid rgba(245, 203, 101, .5);
	border-radius: 18px;
	background: rgba(245, 203, 101, .1);
	font-size: 13px;
}
.wbt-js .wbt-next { display: inline-flex; }
.wbt .wbt-next .wbt-ico { width: 28px; height: 30px; border-radius: 6px; }
.wbt-next-label { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #f5cb65; }
.wbt-next-name { font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; }
.wbt-next-when { color: #c9bfb0; }
.wbt-next-left { font-weight: 700; color: #f5cb65; }
/* mode=next (Main Page): only the bar, over the dark hero picture so it keeps its dark look in the light theme too */
.wbt-mini { display: none; margin: 16px 0 0; text-align: center; }
.wbt-mini.wbt-js { display: block; }
.wbt.wbt-mini .wbt-days { display: none !important; }
.wbt-mini .wbt-next-in .wbt-ico { order: -1; }
.wbt-mini .wbt-next { padding: 0; background: rgba(20, 18, 16, .72); border-radius: 6px; }
.wbt-next-in { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px 10px; padding: 5px 14px 5px 6px; color: inherit; border-radius: 6px; }
.wbt-next-in, .wbt-next-in:visited, .wbt-next-in:hover { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
.wbt-next-in:hover { filter: brightness(1.2); }
/* the Main Page hero makes every image fill the hero, undo that for the icon */
.aa-mp-hero .wbt-mini img, .wbt-mini img { position: static; inset: auto; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; max-width: none; }
/* the seven days */
.wbt-days {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr));
	gap: 10px;
	align-items: start;
}
.wbt-day { min-width: 0; }
.wbt-dayhead {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: space-between;
	padding: 8px 10px;
	border: 1px solid #3a3430;
	border-radius: 8px;
	background: #241d18;
	font-size: 13px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: .1em;
	color: #c9bfb0;
}
.wbt-today { display: none; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #e8e1d6; }
.wbt-day-today .wbt-today { display: inline; }
.wbt-day-today .wbt-dayhead { border-color: rgba(232, 225, 214, .5); background: rgba(232, 225, 214, .1); color: #ffffff; }
.wbt-events { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-top: 10px; }
/* one spawn */
.wbt-ev {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 6px;
	padding: 10px 10px 12px;
	border: 1px solid #3a3430;
	border-radius: 8px;
	background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .035);
}
.wbt-time {
	order: 1;
	padding: 3px 10px;
	border: 1px solid transparent;
	border-radius: 6px;
	font-size: 17px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: .03em;
	white-space: nowrap;
}
.wbt-ico {
	order: 2;
	position: relative;
	display: block;
	flex: none;
	width: 34px;
	height: 36px;
	overflow: hidden;
	border-radius: 6px;
	background: #26211d;
}
.wbt-pic { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.wbt-pic span { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.wbt-pic img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; max-width: none; object-fit: cover; }
/* a random slot of two bosses: the left half and the right half of the box */
.wbt-pic-l, .wbt-pic-r { position: absolute; top: 0; width: 50%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }
.wbt-pic-l { left: 0; }
.wbt-pic-r { left: 50%; }
.wbt-pic-l img, .wbt-pic-r img { position: absolute; top: 0; width: 200%; height: 100%; }
.wbt-pic-l img { left: 0; }
.wbt-pic-r img { right: 0; }
.wbt-text { order: 3; display: flex; flex: 0 0 100%; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; margin-top: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.wbt-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; color: #e8e1d6; }
/* a name that links to its boss page keeps the white text */
.wbt-name a, .wbt-name a:visited, .wbt-name a:hover, .wbt-name a.new, .wbt-name a.new:visited { color: inherit; }
.wbt-name a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.wbt-sub { font-size: 12px; color: #9a9082; }
.wbt-nexttag { display: none; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; color: #f5cb65; }
.wbt-ev.wbt-isnext { border-color: rgba(245, 203, 101, .7); background: rgba(245, 203, 101, .07); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(245, 203, 101, .18); }
.wbt-isnext .wbt-nexttag { display: block; }
/* Primal bosses get a coloured outline */
.wbt-ring-pa::after, .wbt-ring-pkr::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 3; border: 1.5px solid; border-radius: 6px; }
.wbt-ring-pa::after { border-color: #b98cf0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 8px rgba(185, 140, 240, .6); }
.wbt-ring-pkr::after { border-color: #7fd0f5; box-shadow: inset 0 0 8px rgba(127, 208, 245, .6); }
.wbt-events:empty::after { content: "No spawns"; color: #6f6a5e; font-size: 12px; font-style: italic; text-align: center; }
/* chip colours */
.wbt-c-rd .wbt-time { color: #ff8a75; background: rgba(240, 86, 60, .16); border-color: rgba(240, 86, 60, .5); }
.wbt-c-pa .wbt-time { color: #c9a9ff; background: rgba(185, 140, 240, .16); border-color: rgba(185, 140, 240, .5); }

.wbt-c-kr .wbt-time { color: #7fd0f5; background: rgba(127, 208, 245, .14); border-color: rgba(127, 208, 245, .45); }
.wbt-c-pkr .wbt-time { color: #7fd0f5; background: rgba(127, 208, 245, .14); border-color: rgba(127, 208, 245, .45); }
.wbt-c-ber .wbt-time { color: #ffb454; background: rgba(255, 156, 39, .16); border-color: rgba(255, 156, 39, .5); }
.wbt-c-mix .wbt-time { color: #f5cb65; background: rgba(245, 203, 101, .14); border-color: rgba(245, 203, 101, .45); }
.wbt-c-rdpa .wbt-time { color: #f3ece6; border-color: transparent; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(240, 86, 60, .24) 50%, rgba(185, 140, 240, .24) 50%) padding-box, linear-gradient(#241d18, #241d18) padding-box, linear-gradient(90deg, #f0563c 50%, #b98cf0 50%) border-box; }
/* 12 hour clock (set by the script): the chips are wider, so they and the icons get a bit smaller in the columns */
.wbt-12h .wbt-ev { gap: 4px; padding: 10px 8px 12px; }
.wbt-12h .wbt-time { padding: 2px 5px; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0; }
.wbt-12h .wbt-ico { width: 28px; height: 30px; }
/* the day by day list, for phones (layout=agenda always, layout=auto on narrow screens) */
.wbt-agenda .wbt-days { display: block; }
.wbt-agenda .wbt-day { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.wbt-agenda .wbt-dayhead { padding: 6px 4px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #3a3430; border-radius: 0; background: none; }

}
@media (max-width: 500px) {
	.wbt-top { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
	.wbt-tz, .wbt-next { margin-left: 0; }
